titles.title: PIC and POPs Conventions and the LRTAP POPs Protocol Implementation Act

To amend the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act to implement pesticide-related obligations of the United States under the international conventions or protocols known as the PIC Convention, the POPs Convention, and the LRTAP POPs Protocol.
